newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bouygues Telecom has 23 bln Ffr financing.
newsitem.headline: Bouygues Telecom has 23 bln Ffr financing.

text.p: Bouygues said in a statement that its Bouygues Telecom unit would increase the development of its mobile telecommunications network because it expected more subscribers and a bigger market share.
It said it expected two million subscribers in a total market of nine million by the year 2000, while it previously said it wanted to have 1.5 million in a market of seven million clients.
As a result, the company has a maximum financing need of 23 billion francs of which eight billion francs will be in equity and near-equity and 15 billion in a syndicated bank loan.
